prose: Bloomberg examines China's bid to convert excess wind and solar into an AI advantage through a $3.9 trillion grid buildout through 2049 - a bet made urgent by curtailment, with roughly 9% of renewable output wasted in 2026. Basis: the article is paywalled and only the headline framing was retrievable, so this summary reflects the reported premise rather than the full piece.
highlights: China plans a $3.9T grid buildout through 2049 to power an AI edge.
~9% of renewable output was wasted in 2026 - excess energy seeking a use.
Basis: Bloomberg paywall - headline framing only.
